name: autoclaude
description: AutoClaude: runs a project's PLAN.md step by step, unattended, and verifies every step before moving on. Add it with `claude plugin marketplace add <owner>/<repo>` (or a local clone's path), then `claude plugin install autoclaude@autoclaude`.
